title: astragalus deanei
intro: Astragalus deanei, commonly known as Deane's milkvetch, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include immune system support, anti-inflammatory properties, and antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus deanei include its ability to modulate the immune response, reduce inflammation, and exhibit cardiotonic and adaptogenic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
